proxyConfiguration: Use only the environment-provided HTTP(S) proxy and NO_PROXY settings without reading or changing their values.
tlsPolicy: Preserve TLS certificate verification and existing trust; no insecure flags or new trust roots.
captureGate: Only a 200 diagnostic response matching the published selected PR merge identity permits capture.
requestAccounting: Count all new attempts, including failed reads, license, commit and tree requests; consume the remaining shared allowance.
stopRules: Stop on any error or identity mismatch.
No automatic retries, direct fallback, credentials or endpoint substitutions.
No W1/W2 source, diff, discussion, label or model-output reads.
oldRecords: Preserve both previous attempts unchanged; exclusive output creation prevents a silent rerun.
evidenceBoundary: Current W0 observations remain quarantined, not historical human labels or mined rules.
causalCaveat: Enabling the existing environment proxy is a supported client configuration correction, not proof it was the sole cause of either earlier error.
